description: Selected motion-only regression excerpts from labelled badge captures. Original browser/acquisition timestamps, axes, sequence, accepted ages and flags are retained. No microphone text or audio. Positive excerpts keep one second before Move and all three Move seconds; the five completed Still trials retain continuous context because lowering suppression has state. The validation recording exposed a preparatory stroke and was subsequently used for diagnosis, so these are regression data, not untouched accuracy holdouts.
